scope: Seven-file pure protocol/provider candidate and isolated local coordinator tests only; no canonical coordinator, Telegram, runtime or task mutations.

findings.problem: Decoder reads optional expires_us with zero default. Canonical receipt_json emits expires_boot_us. A genuine isolated authority.run_at claim was rejected; invented expires_us-only fixture accepted.
findings.fix: Require canonical expires_boot_us for claim/renew with positive epoch/future deadline, no alias/default. Test actual register/claim/renew/release formatter and authority.run_at outputs, including epoch greater than one, wrong/missing/null fields and alias rejection.

findings.problem: Changing exact required events_payload SQL without an upgrade path prevents new open_existing on every old-schema valid DB. CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS in open does not replace the old trigger. Reproduced with an isolated one-event DB created through the current root writer.
findings.fix: Provide separately authorized, reviewed schema transition or staged candidate migration with old/new precondition hashes, writer quiescence/fencing, preserved event bytes and rollback. Prove old-provider replay and all guard/digest controls before/after. Do not silently loosen exact verification or mutate production on open.

findings.problem: int.parse alone accepts noncanonical '+1'/'01' attempts and signed '+2000000000' deadline. Independent controls observed acceptance despite strict decimal contract.
findings.fix: Require bounded ASCII digits with canonical round-trip representation and strictly positive/future values; reject signs, leading zeros, whitespace, numeric JSON types, oversized strings, and missing fields.

findings.problem: Response mismatch and unrecognized-value errors concatenate received operation/task/claimed values; parse errors inspect decoder failures. PRIVATE_SENTINEL was reflected verbatim in actual error output.
findings.fix: Return finite redacted error codes; never echo response/expected private values. Bound input before parsing and test sentinel non-disclosure on all decoder refusal branches.

findings.problem: Generic identifier helper silently trims identity values and permits characters rejected by coordinator identifiers. Claim builder accepts session 'bad id', operation ' op '->'op', and TTL3601 though coordinator maximum is3600 seconds.
findings.fix: Use exact downstream identifier constraints without silent normalization; separate identifier/workspace/ref validation. Apply coordinator TTL bounds or finite service-selected TTL and test boundaries against actual downstream command parsing.

tests.independent_actual_claim: New private DB service registration and actual authority.run_at claim succeeded; protocol rejected the genuine JSON.
tests.old_schema: Old root writer created valid one-event private DB. New open_existing refused. New open followed by verify retained exact-trigger failure.
tests.pure_controls: Actual receipt serializer fails decoder; invented alias accepted; noncanonical decimals accepted; invalid session/excess TTL accepted by builder; private sentinel reflected.
tests.preserved_failure: First old-fixture launcher matched simplifile mkdir result as ok instead of {ok,nil}; exited before DB creation. Corrected invocation succeeded; outputs retained.

accepted_limits: Typed Provider renderer/parser preserves claude/codex/agy wire labels and adds service. Fresh-store registration/refusal/replay controls passed.
None risk adapter fails closed. Injected mock pass is development only; no real risk validator or runtime authorization is established.
